title: La Grande Jatte
hook: Everyone in this park is hiding something.
caption:
Everyone in this park is hiding something.

Seurat was 24 when he started A Sunday on La Grande Jatte, and he spent two years on it: oil sketches on the island, shadowy crayon drawings, a full dress rehearsal. Then came the dots, the 1886 scandal at the last Impressionist show, a border he painted on later… and a sunny yellow that has been quietly turning brown ever since.

Oh, and that monkey on a leash? Many historians think it's a joke.

Swipe through, then watch the reel to find it yourself. Save this for your next visit to Chicago.
